#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -u
task_root=/home/rich/.codex/worktrees/listindex-numeric-5611/Project-Copperfin
cd "$task_root" || exit 1
# Exact observed task-owned expanded-driver PID; validate before waiting.
if test -d /proc/496856; then
 test "$(readlink /proc/496856/cwd)" = "$task_root" || exit 2
 tr '\0' ' ' < /proc/496856/cmdline | rg -F 'bash tests/fixtures/vfp9-listindex-numeric/ci-expanded-suites.sh.txt' > /dev/null || exit 3
 tail --pid=496856 --sleep-interval=1 -f /dev/null || exit 4
fi
for task_status in ci-expanded-gcc ci-expanded-clang ci-expanded-preservation-gcc ci-expanded-preservation-clang; do
 test -f "build/listindex-native/$task_status.status" || exit 5
 test "$(cat "build/listindex-native/$task_status.status")" = 0 || exit 6
done
sha256sum -c tests/fixtures/vfp9-listindex-numeric/ci-expanded.sha256 > build/listindex-native/ci-contracts-before.log || exit 7
export TMPDIR="$task_root/build/listindex-tmp"
export COPPERFIN_LOCALE_DIR="$task_root/resources/locales"
unset ASAN_OPTIONS UBSAN_OPTIONS
nice -n 10 ionice -c 2 -n 7 ctest --test-dir build/listindex-gcc -V --output-on-failure --timeout 600 -j 1 -R '^(test_contributor_signoff_contract|test_changelog_fragment_assembler|test_changelog_fragments_valid|test_agent_channel_contract|test_safety_traceability_workflow_contract)$' > build/listindex-native/ci-contracts.log 2>&1
task_status=$?
printf '%s\n' "$task_status" > build/listindex-native/ci-contracts.status
date -u '+%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ' > build/listindex-native/ci-contracts.completed-at
sha256sum build/listindex-native/ci-contracts.log > build/listindex-native/ci-contracts.log.sha256
test "$task_status" -eq 0 || exit "$task_status"
sha256sum -c tests/fixtures/vfp9-listindex-numeric/ci-expanded.sha256 > build/listindex-native/ci-contracts-after.log || exit 8
